description: This Kotlin source file defines a RecyclerView adapter called RecipeAdapter for rendering RecipeEntity items as cards. It handles item display, click interactions, and favorite toggle functionality.

classes.name: RecipeAdapter
classes.description: An adapter for a RecyclerView that displays RecipeEntity items as interactive cards, supporting item clicks and favorite toggling.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new RecipeVH view holder by inflating the item_recipe_card layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the provided view holder based on the item position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of RecipeEntity items in the adapter.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Updates the adapter's data set with a new list of RecipeEntity items and refreshes the view.

inner_classes.name: RecipeVH
inner_classes.description: ViewHolder class that binds individual RecipeEntity data to the UI components in the recipe card layout.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a RecipeEntity item to the ViewHolder UI components and sets up click listeners for item interaction and favorite toggle.
